verdict.rationale: Browser Use is an AI browser-agent platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows agents that run web tasks and return results, such as structured data extraction or CSV export, but nothing documents the product generating insights or suggestions from the user's own data inside the product. Task extraction examples are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
